entities.name: Procedure Transaction Identity
entities.description: Identifier used in ESM messages to correlate request and response messages for a specific procedure transaction.

entities.name: ESM cause #81
entities.description: Invalid PTI value cause code used in reject messages when an unassigned or reserved PTI value is received.

entities.name: ESM cause #47
entities.description: PTI mismatch cause code used when an assigned PTI value does not match any ongoing transaction.

entities.name: Invalid PTI condition
entities.description: Condition where received PTI is unassigned, reserved, or does not match any ongoing transaction.

entities.name: Ignore message
entities.description: Behavior where the receiver discards the message without further processing.

entities.name: Send reject message
entities.description: Behavior where the receiver responds with a reject message containing appropriate ESM cause.

relations.description: Invalid PTI condition leads to message being ignored in specified scenarios.
Invalid PTI condition leads to sending reject message with ESM cause.
Reject messages contain ESM cause #81 for invalid PTI values.
Reject messages contain ESM cause #47 for PTI mismatch conditions.
PTI value is checked against invalid conditions (unassigned, reserved, or mismatch).
